selection: whole uploaded recording, two fixed 30s windows; no result-based selection
crop_rule: fixed square selected from source images before prediction
video_timing: container PTS preserved; nearest frame to uniform 30Hz, then existing BigSmall 25Hz mapping
gt_timing: original third-row timestamps, zero start offset, no fitted delay or temporal warp
gt_limit: same-index GT timestamps differ from container PTS by up to about 0.373s; physical synchronization not independently verified
gap_rule: linear interpolation across recorded gaps up to fixed 250ms cap; preserve and flag gaps over100ms, exclude none post hoc
evaluation_spectrum: Hann, constant detrend, no zero padding
